source: user DC multimeter reading at R AT8236 module AIN1-to-GND
procedure_requested: VM disconnected, FPGA logic powered; release both keys, hold only S2 once, read during D2 active interval of about 1 second.
input_net: RAIN1, R header pin 5, FPGA F13 / P7-7
comparison: Consistent with the expected DC average of nominal 3.3V at the 50% PWM plateau; this is not a waveform measurement.
next_measurement_requested: VM still disconnected. R module AIN2-to-GND during one S2 hold, D2 active.
